# Preserved Swiper navigation glyphs

Only the MIT-licensed icon font from Swiper 8.4.7 is retained here, with a scoped
font name and the existing arrow width/position. Swiper 14 supplies the runtime,
React components, types, navigation behavior and other styles. Its default SVG
arrows change the sites' appearance, so the CMS renderer disables `addIcons` and
uses these glyphs. This is a visual compatibility asset, not a second runtime.
